{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Identify QA orders (revenue = '999999.99')
qa_orders = sales[sales['revenue'] == '999999.99']

# Check if any QA orders have customer_age == -1
print("Are any QA orders missing age (age == -1)?")
print(qa_orders['customer_age'].eq(-1).any())

# Check if QA orders have valid age values
print("QA order ages:")
print(qa_orders['customer_age'])

# Check if QA orders are included in the customer_age mean calculation
print("Number of QA orders:")
print(len(qa_orders))"}
